description: A Severance 400 bolted to the wall: coin slot and thermal printer up top, an amber screen of open contracts, a round stainless port by your knees with a scale behind it. PAYABLE ON DELIVERY. DO NOT INSERT LIVING TISSUE. This one is looked after, wiped down every shift. Nobody will say who does it.

receptacle.accept: The port cycles smoothly, the way a serviced machine does. A soft double click behind the inner door, then nothing.
receptacle.dark: The port is locked solid. The terminal has gone dark, and whatever is in it's staying in it.
receptacle.darkPost: The terminal is dark. No printer, no sheet, and nobody here is writing one by hand.
receptacle.empty: A contract pays on delivery, and the port stays shut for anyone arriving without one.
receptacle.room: {handle} crouches at the terminal behind the bar. It pays out {amount} in clean notes, and the bartender finds something to do at the other end of the room.

name: bounty terminal
